bioAdditions: Both of John Joseph's draft cards confirm his birth on 9 April 1883 at Hazleton. In 1918 he was a 35-year-old merchant with his own business at 1013 Hamilton Street, Allentown. He lived at 519 Turner Street, and his nearest relative was Mary Meier at the same address, probably his wife (S1). By April 1942 he was 59, unemployed, and gave his home as 350 Kiefer Avenue, Hazleton. The person who would always know his address was 'Mrs. John Brill' at that house. Oddly, the card was stamped by Local Board No. 2 of Clarion County at Sligo, PA, so he was probably working or staying in western Pennsylvania when he registered (S2). The registrar noted two scars on the back of his head. FamilySearch has his death on 2 Oct 1966 at Maple Shade, NJ (SSDI) and burial at Hazleton (S3).
openQuestionsNew: Who was Mary Meier of 519 Turner St, Allentown (1918): a wife? A 1920 Allentown census search for John J. and Mary Meier is needed.
Who was Mrs. John Brill of 350 Kiefer Ave, Hazleton (1942)? Possibly a niece.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Two draft cards in his own hand give the same birth date and birthplace (Hazleton) as the tree.
